scripts.build: npm run build -w @llavon/web && npm run build -w @llavon/worker
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @llavon/web && concurrently -n web,worker -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @llavon/web" "npm run dev -w @llavon/worker"
scripts.deploy: npm run build -w @llavon/web && npm run deploy -w @llavon/worker
